purpose: Compact extracted final results with local source identities; full detail remains in referenced artifacts.

checkpoint_evaluations.timing_scope: Saved episode seconds and episodes/s, including diagnostic capture; startup/restore/output/offline analysis excluded.

scope: Direct archived-state evidence covers iterations 100/200/300/400/500 only.
Initial weights were not persisted; no initial-to-final identity or every-optimizer-step immutability claim is made.
Encoder changes establish parameter updates between saved states, not direct gradient measurements or a cause of quality differences.
One training seed only; no training-seed variance, evaluation quality, or speed claim is supported by this audit.
Catalog graph buffers and policy heads are audited separately from learned encoder parameters; nonpersistent embedding caches are excluded.

Each inspected policy pickle and checkpoint metadata matches the completed training-file audit and every corresponding evaluation source-identity record; iteration 500 matches both stochastic and greedy evaluation sources.

post_evaluation_report_source_changes.classification: Known visualization-only change after completed GPU evaluations; evaluation/core runtime files are unchanged; no direct reference to learning_report in checked runtime modules.

provenance.final_result_commit_scope: The training/evaluation runtime revision is pinned above; the later result/report commit is not inferred from this summary.

scope.n1: One training seed. Episode samples are not training-seed replicates; sample SD across training seeds is undefined. No statistical superiority or causal claim is established.
scope.matched_budget: Matched100 uses explicit episode seeds0..99 for each checkpoint; final500 is the first100 of its saved1000 episodes. Compare unique fractions only with equal budgets. Old13 and final500 separately use1000 episodes each.
scope.greedy: Greedy10 uses the same initial molecule C and fixed table. Different reset seeds do not create independent greedy policy replicates.
scope.training_vs_evaluation: Training QED is episode-weighted within changing-policy training; fixed-checkpoint evaluation QED is a separate measurement. Decision steps are not molecular updates.
scope.timing: Evaluation episode time includes diagnostic capture overhead, excludes model startup/restore/output and offline chemistry analysis. Training speed is measured without this diagnostic capture.
scope.resource_comparison: Object-store capacity differs across old/new checkpoint groups. Evaluation uses no rollout workers; initialization is outside rollout timing, but memory conditions are not strictly matched. Do not claim a strictly matched inference speedup from these times.
scope.gpu_memory: Report observed shared-process allocated peaks. Do not attribute the actor_value versus actor peak difference solely to U architecture. Do not claim reserved-memory measurements or an isolated per-job memory benchmark.
scope.initial_encoder_weights: Initial weights were not persisted. Encoder identity/update evidence is limited to archived iterations100/200/300/400/500, and is not direct gradient observation or a proof about every intermediate optimizer step.
scope.frozen_mpnn: The frozen MPNN encoder is randomly initialized, not pretrained.
scope.candidate_cap: Cap frequency measures discarded candidates; it does not establish lost future return. Optional offline audits compare immediate QED only.
scope.best_visited: Includes the initial molecule and actually selected intermediates. Final score is primary. Gaps do not quantify the benefit of an untested STOP action.
scope.no_candidate_end: Only the chosen building-block and current-molecule pair has no candidates; this does not prove that every block is impossible or that stopping was intentional.
scope.fragment_coverage: Reports selected table rows and canonical structures; unused fragments are not demonstrated unreachable or unnecessary.
scope.quality_thresholds: QED>=.90 and>=.94 are inclusive post-hoc sensitivity cuts on saved scores. Conditional subset sizes differ; numerical quality does not establish synthetic feasibility or usefulness.
scope.chemistry_and_diversity: This file only extracts saved aggregates. No new canonicalization, QED, fingerprint, descriptor, scaffold, model or GPU computation.
scope.ray_tail: Coverage rows preserve signed dump-minus-final-end seconds. Negative values leave an explicitly unproven final interval; later observation time does not extend dump coverage.
scope.source_identity: All49 core hashes match archived audit/execution identities. The known learning_report.py visualization-only edit after evaluation is explicitly separate from runtime provenance.

source_path_scope: Paths are relative to the repository root. Source inventory excludes summary.json itself to avoid a recursive self-hash.

report_file_preparation.operation: Remove exporter-generated trailing whitespace from three SVG text files for Git storage. Raw report artifacts are unchanged; XML structure and whitespace-normalized attributes are identical. PNG images and numeric report data are unchanged.
